input.what: The original, unedited phone video file (full length, straight from the device, not re-exported or messaged), ideally 10+ minutes of continuous recording under the same lights; and any other recording made at the same place around the same time.
input.why: The 3-minute excerpt does contain a clear mains flicker signal, and its best match is 11:50:06 on 08 Nov, 1 s from the claim. But only 15-second grid data exists for November 2026, and against that, 164 s of signal is not distinctive. A clip on 05 Nov matches equally well (0.9817 vs 0.9813), and the first half of the clip on its own points to a different time. A longer continuous recording would make the match unique, and the original file would let us check for edits.
